dimensions.assessment: Affects junior enlisted service members with dependents or pregnant spouses undergoing permanent changes of station.
dimensions.evidence: covered member of the Armed Forces means an enlisted member of the Armed Forces who is undergoing a permanent change of station

dimensions.assessment: Streamlines WIC notifications, temporary presumptive eligibility, and certification card transfers during military relocations.
dimensions.evidence: treat that individual and every participant who is a member of the family of that individual as presumptively eligible

dimensions.assessment: Requires staffing military installations and administrative coordination, but does not provide specific funding amounts.
dimensions.evidence: each military installation is staffed at least 3 days per week by appropriate military personnel

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Child Nutrition Act of 1966 and imposes new notification and staffing duties on the Department of Defense.
dimensions.evidence: To require that certain notifications and certifications relating to WIC be available to members of the Armed Forces

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent requirements for military notifications, state agency rules, and installation staffing.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Defense shall ensure that each military installation is staffed

importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Department of Defense to notify certain enlisted service members undergoing a permanent change of station about WIC eligibility, mandates state agency verification of certification cards and presumptive eligibility, and requires WIC staffing at military installations.
